info.title: Technology Problem Tracker API
info.description: Public browsing and authenticated contribution. Moderator endpoints require stored moderator/admin roles. No email or privileged credentials appear in responses.

get.summary: Discover problems; returns at most 50 results

patch.summary: Edit your report; requires the current version

put.summary: Set your affected confirmation, vote, or follow

get.summary: A solution and its revision history

put.summary: Set one test result per user per revision

post.summary: Attach a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, at most 500 KB
Review current independent test evidence; self review prohibited
Change a problem lifecycle status with a reason
Resolve a moderation report with an audit reason
